---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
```

```{r}
# Load the data
feature_df <- read_excel("mannwhitney_with_rankbiserial.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")
abundance_df <- read_excel("df_features.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")

feature_list <- feature_df$Feature

# Filter to include only selected samples and Groups
abundance_df <- abundance_df %>%
  filter(Criteria_BaselineVsTD == "Include", Group %in% c("Baseline", "TD")) %>%
  rename(Group_for_plot = Group)
```

```{r}
table(abundance_df$Group_for_plot)
```


```{r}
# Ensure feature names match and trim whitespace if necessary
feature_df$Feature <- trimws(feature_df$Feature)
colnames(abundance_df) <- trimws(colnames(abundance_df))

# Filter feature_df for only features present in abundance_df
common_features <- intersect(feature_df$Feature, colnames(abundance_df))
feature_df <- feature_df %>% filter(Feature %in% common_features)

# Reshape abundance data
long_df <- abundance_df %>%
  select(SampleID, Group_for_plot, all_of(feature_df$Feature)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(SampleID, Group_for_plot),
    names_to = "Microbe",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )
```

```{r}
box_plot <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = Microbe, y = Abundance, fill = Group_for_plot, color = Group_for_plot)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TD" = "blue", "Baseline" = "red")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TD" = "blue", "Baseline" = "red")) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 1, b = 0, l = 5.5, r = 5.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "Relative Abundance (log10 scale)") +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l")

effect_plot <- ggplot(feature_df, aes(x = Feature, y = RankBiserial_r_abs, color = EnrichedCohort)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TD" = "blue", "Baseline" = "red")) +
  ylim(0.2, max(feature_df$RankBiserial_r_abs, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.25) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, face = "italic"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 5.5, l = 5.5, r = 5.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "Effect Size")
```

```{r}
box_plot <- box_plot + scale_x_discrete(limits = feature_df$Feature)
effect_plot <- effect_plot + scale_x_discrete(limits = feature_df$Feature)

box_plot <- box_plot + theme(legend.position = "right")

# Convert ggplots to gtables
g1 <- ggplotGrob(box_plot)
g2 <- ggplotGrob(effect_plot)

# Make the overall column widths identical so panels/axes align perfectly
max_widths <- unit.pmax(g1$widths, g2$widths)
g1$widths <- max_widths
g2$widths <- max_widths

# Stack them with minimal padding
combined_plot <- arrangeGrob(
  g1, g2,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1.3, 1),
  padding = unit(0, "line")
)
```

```{r}
ggsave("Box_plot_TD_vs_Baseline.png", plot = combined_plot, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 500)
ggsave("Box_plot_TD_vs_Baseline.pdf", plot = combined_plot, width = 10, height = 10)
```
